unit_types.name: UnitType33_SpecialFootPersonage
unit_types.evidence: This record reuses the `Dowódca / Tactician / Soldat` localized-name table, keeps infantry-like movement assets, enters the prisoner queue on capture, and is also instantiated by `Queen_NewTurn` through `Building_CreateSpecialPersonageGarrisonUnit`. The queen-turn path binds type `33` specifically to the son outcome before formatting `g_QueenSonBirthTexts`. The asm-backed garrison helper shows the same id being installed through the normal `UnitSlot_InitFromType` path and then marked as a resident special occupant inside the building slot. The `specm` code name argues for a broader special-personage role rather than a prisoner-only one.

unit_types.name: UnitType34_SpecialMountedPersonage
unit_types.evidence: This record reuses the same localized-name table, switches to mounted movement assets, participates in the same prisoner pipeline as type `33`, and is also emitted by the queen birth path. The queen-turn path binds type `34` specifically to the daughter outcome before formatting `g_QueenDaughterBirthTexts`. The same asm-backed helper shows the mounted variant using the ordinary building garrison slot layout instead of a separate royal-only record path. The `speck` code name and the daughter-birth text about becoming an officer reinforce the same shared special-personage family.

unit_categories.name: RangedUnitCategory
unit_categories.evidence: Only units with non-zero `g_UnitTypeMaxRange` enter the projectile logic, use `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveShotPower`, and obey the min/max range tables.

unit_categories.name: FlyingUnitCategory
unit_categories.evidence: `g_UnitTypeFlags` bit0 changes render order, movement sounds, death handling, and stack-level airborne predicates.

unit_categories.name: GroundUnitCategory
unit_categories.evidence: Non-airborne units use ordinary melee, terrain/surface-dependent move sounds, and the ground render pass.

unit_categories.name: LightUnitCategory
unit_categories.evidence: `g_UnitTypeFlags` bit1 selects the lower 6-point morale seed path instead of the default 10-point seed.

unit_categories.name: SpecialCargoEntryCategory
unit_categories.evidence: Types `31` and `32` are excluded by `UnitStack_HasNormalCombatUnits`, transferred separately during capture, feed gold/peasant-specific stack logic, count as noncombat building occupants when present in castle garrisons, and cannot satisfy the port-reinforcement pickup gate because that gate requires at least one normal combat unit in the claiming stack.

unit_categories.name: SpecialPersonageCategory
unit_categories.evidence: Types `33` and `34` are non-standard special personage entries: capture logic routes them through per-player prisoner transit storage, `Queen_NewTurn` also creates the same ids directly inside building garrisons, fatigue/morale adjustment paths explicitly skip them, military-strength scoring first detects their presence before calling the core combat-strength helper, and personage-only stacks still fail the port-reinforcement pickup gate because that gate also requires normal combat units. The asm-backed `Building_CreateSpecialPersonageGarrisonUnit` body confirms that these ids are written into the normal 12-slot building garrison array through `UnitSlot_InitFromType` and then flagged as resident special occupants; those resident-slot bits exclude them from generic castle training, while `Building_CountNonCombatGarrisonEntries` also classifies them as noncombat building occupants. Supporting gameplay predicates now consistently name this family as `special personage` rather than `prisoner`.

unit_categories.name: PortReinforcementUnitTypePool
unit_categories.evidence: `Port_CollectReinforcementShipment` seeds each spawned slot by drawing a random entry from the fixed unit-type table `{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10, 15, 16, 17}`, so the port reinforcement roster is limited to peasant, infantry, cavalry, archer, forester, goral, and builder units rather than cargo, special-personage, siege, or monster ids.

stats.name: base_action_points
stats.semantic_role: per-type maximum action-point budget before fatigue penalties
stats.evidence: Stored in `g_UnitTypeBaseActionPoints`, copied into slot +8 on init, and used by `UnitSlot_CalcActionPointsFromFatigue`.

stats.name: current_action_points
stats.semantic_role: runtime action points available to the slot this turn
stats.evidence: Lives at UnitSlotRecord +8, is refreshed each new turn from the base AP table after fatigue thresholds are applied, and tactical battle restores the pre-battle source value before survivors are copied back out through `Battle_RestoreSavedActionPointsBeforeResultCopy`.

stats.name: current_health_percent
stats.semantic_role: runtime health or squad strength percentage
stats.evidence: Initialized to 100 for ordinary units, scales effective attack and damage helpers, a zero value kills the slot, and the detach/regroup helpers also classify slots from this byte (`<= 10` weak cutoff, `>= 8` stronger regroup threshold). Cargo types `31` and `32` reuse the same byte as transfer payload quantity during treasury/population export and reward flows.

stats.name: fatigue
stats.semantic_role: runtime exhaustion counter that throttles action points and morale
stats.evidence: Lives at UnitSlotRecord +10, drops by 20 on recovery turns, and thresholds at 80/90/100 reduce available action points.

stats.name: morale
stats.semantic_role: runtime 0-20 morale/obedience score that boosts combat stats and can cause order refusal
stats.evidence: Lives at UnitSlotRecord +11, is clamped to 0..20, adds into attack and damage helpers, drives the low-morale refusal flag, and is shown in the selected-unit battle panel through the same five-tier 0..20 presentation bucket.

stats.name: stance_bits
stats.semantic_role: runtime packed status/order/volley byte that modifies combat and garrison behavior
stats.evidence: Bits `0..1` of UnitSlotRecord +12 feed melee, defense-power, and wall-attack helpers directly, and value `3` is the resident special-occupant state written by `Building_CreateSpecialPersonageGarrisonUnit`. Bits `2..3` form a separate order/state subfield, bits `4..6` track `volleys_used` and are incremented by ranged fire before being compared against `status_level + 1`, and only bit `7` remains unresolved.

stats.name: state_flags
stats.semantic_role: runtime ready/spent-turn/refusal/plague flag byte
stats.evidence: Bit 0x1 drives `UnitStack_HasReadyUnits`, bit 0x2 is set and cleared by the spent-turn helpers and gates fatigue recovery, bit 0x4 marks low-morale refusal, and bit 0x8 is the plague marker used by plague spread and peasant-cargo attrition.

stats.name: base_melee_attack
stats.semantic_role: primary melee attack rating
stats.evidence: Non-zero values gate standard melee and feed `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveMeleeAttack`.

stats.name: base_defense_power
stats.semantic_role: per-type defence rating used by combat resistance math and the battle UI
stats.evidence: Stored in `g_UnitTypeBaseDefensePower`, consumed by `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveDefensePower`, summed by `UnitSlots_CalcDefenseScore`, and reused by melee exchange, trap damage, and shot-damage mitigation.

stats.name: base_shot_power
stats.semantic_role: per-type projectile or shot-power value before health scaling
stats.evidence: Stored in `g_UnitTypeBaseShotPower`, consumed by `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveShotPower` and `UnitStats_GetBaseShotPower`, and displayed under the `Shot power` UI row.

stats.name: base_wall_attack
stats.semantic_role: per-type wall-assault strength used against fortification sections
stats.evidence: Stored in `g_UnitTypeBaseWallAttack`, consumed by `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveWallAttack`, and applied directly to wall-section health during `UnitBattle_AttackWall`.

stats.name: road_move_cost
stats.semantic_role: move cost on road and bridge overlays
stats.evidence: Returned from `g_UnitTypeRoadMoveCost` whenever the world-map tile record has a road or bridge overlay.

stats.name: world_surface_move_costs[8]
stats.semantic_role: eight-lane normalized world-surface movement profile
stats.evidence: Combined with `g_TerrainMoveTableOffsets` in the world movement helpers after raw terrain ids collapse into one of eight normalized lanes; the currently recovered lane order is `plain_class_a`, `forest`, `desert_class`, `swamp`, `plain_class_b`, `water_surface`, `hills`, `mountains`.

stats.name: battle_tile_move_cost
stats.semantic_role: tactical per-tile movement cost used by battle pathing
stats.evidence: `UnitBattle_InitPathingTables` precomputes a tactical move-cost grid from `BattleRuntimeState.default_tile_move_cost`, while `UnitBattle_GetTileMoveCostOrZero` returns fixed cost `5` for airborne unit types.

stats.name: unit_type_flags
stats.semantic_role: unit-type bitfield inside the 88-byte metadata record
stats.evidence: Bit0 marks airborne types; another flag controls the 6-vs-10 seed path.

stats.name: attack_range_max
stats.semantic_role: maximum projectile range in tiles
stats.evidence: `UnitBattle_IsTileWithinRange` compares the ceil-sqrt tile distance against `g_UnitTypeMaxRange`, and ranged-action setup treats zero as no shot mode.

stats.name: attack_range_min
stats.semantic_role: minimum projectile range or dead-zone floor in tiles
stats.evidence: `UnitBattle_IsTileWithinRange` rejects shots whose ceil-sqrt tile distance is not greater than `g_UnitTypeMinRange`.

stats.name: production_time
stats.semantic_role: per-type number of production turns needed to finish one queued unit
stats.evidence: `Building_SetUnitProduction` copies `g_UnitTypeProductionTime` into `BuildingRecord +415`, and `Building_ProcessUnitProductionTurn` decrements that countdown each turn before reloading the same metadata byte after a completed unit.

stats.name: production_cost
stats.semantic_role: per-type money cost charged when a queued unit finishes production
stats.evidence: `Building_ProcessUnitProductionTurn` reads `g_UnitTypeProductionCost`, compares it against `BuildingRecord.stored_money`, and subtracts the same value when the unit is created.

stats.name: production_licence_cost
stats.semantic_role: per-type money cost to buy the unit's production licence into a building
stats.evidence: `Building_BuyUnitLicence` debits `g_UnitTypeProductionLicenceCost` before appending the unit type into the building's 12-slot licence roster, and `Building_GetTotalValue` adds the same word for each installed licence.

stats.name: production_required_tech_level_mode_2
stats.semantic_role: per-type tech-level threshold used when the production building mode byte equals `2`
stats.evidence: `Building_IsUnitLicenceEligible` selects `g_UnitTypeProductionRequiredTechLevelMode2[88 * unitType]` when `building[4] == 2`, compares that byte against `BuildingRecord.tech_level_bits & 7`, and `CastleProduction_RebuildAvailableUnitList` uses the same gate for the licensable roster.

stats.name: production_required_tech_level_other_modes
stats.semantic_role: per-type tech-level threshold used when the production building mode byte is non-zero but not `2`
stats.evidence: `Building_IsUnitLicenceEligible` switches to `g_UnitTypeProductionRequiredTechLevelOtherModes[88 * unitType]` for the alternate production-building modes and applies the same `tech_level_bits & 7` threshold before the unit licence becomes available.

stats.name: production_requires_smiths
stats.semantic_role: per-type production-licence gate requiring the smiths add-on
stats.evidence: `Building_IsUnitLicenceEligible` scans `g_ProductionLicenceSmithsRequiredUnitTypes` only when smiths bit `0x10` is absent from `BuildingRecord.castle_addon_flags`, so membership in that table is a hard smiths prerequisite for unit-licence eligibility.

stats.name: production_requires_workshop
stats.semantic_role: per-type production-licence gate requiring the workshop add-on
stats.evidence: `Building_IsUnitLicenceEligible` returns early when workshop bit `0x04` is present and otherwise scans `g_ProductionLicenceWorkshopRequiredUnitTypes`, so membership in that table is a hard workshop prerequisite for unit-licence eligibility.

stats.name: construction_progress_per_turn
stats.semantic_role: fixed per-builder construction throughput applied each new turn
stats.evidence: `Building_NewTurn` adds `g_BuilderConstructionProgressPerTurn` for every garrisoned type-17 slot while reducing `BuildingRecord.construction_turns_remaining`, and `Building_CalcRemainingConstructionTurns` divides the remaining timer by the same constant when estimating time left.

stats.name: role
stats.semantic_role: per-type tactical role class used by battle target priorities, role-matchup ordering, and healing eligibility
stats.evidence: The metadata parser loads the literal `role` field into `g_UnitTypeRole`, battle helpers index role-priority tables through that byte, and `UnitStack_HasUnitsNeedingHealing` only counts low-health slots whose role class is at least `3`.

stats.name: move_pixel_speed
stats.semantic_role: per-frame displacement during movement animation
stats.evidence: Movement loops multiply direction vectors by `byte_512570`.

stats.name: move_tick_delay
stats.semantic_role: delay between movement animation ticks
stats.evidence: `Time_Now` gates movement animation advancement with `byte_512571`.

stats.name: animation_frame_interval
stats.semantic_role: shared per-type frame delay for idle and attack animation loops
stats.evidence: World idle animation, battle idle animation, melee attack loops, and ranged attack loops all gate frame advancement with `byte_512572`.

stats.name: animation_flags
stats.semantic_role: per-type animation-behavior bits
stats.evidence: Bit0 gates whether the world-map and battle idle-animation updaters advance the unit's looping frame state.

stats.name: sprite_vertical_offset_px
stats.semantic_role: per-type sprite Y lift in pixels, also reused as an overhang-presence test
stats.evidence: Rendering subtracts `byte_512577` directly from the sprite Y origin, world and battle redraw helpers use the same non-zero values to invalidate neighboring tiles, and only the large overhanging flyers carry non-zero byte values.

stats.name: melee_attack_frame_count
stats.semantic_role: number of frames in the melee attack sheet
stats.evidence: The melee attack animation loop copies `byte_512578` into its frame-count limit before stepping the `_a.s32` sheet.

stats.name: ranged_attack_frame_count
stats.semantic_role: number of frames in the ranged attack sheet
stats.evidence: The shot-animation loop copies `byte_512579` into its frame-count limit before stepping the `_s.s32` sheet.

stats.name: melee_attack_sound_frame
stats.semantic_role: frame index that triggers the melee attack sound
stats.evidence: The melee attack loop plays `Audio_PlayUnitMeleeAttackSound` exactly when the current frame matches `byte_5125B7`.

stats.name: ranged_attack_sound_frame
stats.semantic_role: frame index that triggers the ranged attack sound
stats.evidence: Both ranged animation branches play `Audio_PlayUnitRangedAttackSound` when the current frame matches `byte_5125B8`.

stats.name: move_sound_stem
stats.semantic_role: per-unit movement-sound path stem
stats.evidence: Both movement-sound helpers build `sfx\\ruchy\\<stem>...` from the record field at offset `+81`.

stats.name: move_sound_variant_count
stats.semantic_role: number of alternating movement-sound variants
stats.evidence: The current step variant wraps modulo `g_UnitMoveSoundVariantCounts[88 * type]`.

stats.name: move_sound_base_volume
stats.semantic_role: default movement-sound volume
stats.evidence: Both movement-sound helpers pass `g_UnitMoveSoundBaseVolumes[88 * type]` into `CSS_PlaySound`.

relationships.evidence: Type 13 is explicitly rejected by ordinary melee handlers.

The ram's building-assault combat-strength branch switches to `UnitStats_CalcEffectiveWallAttack` when fortifications are present, and direct tactical wall assaults apply the same stat straight to wall-section health.

Newly created buildings seed `unit_licence_type_ids[0] = 0`, so the first castle production-licence slot is a built-in peasant licence rather than an empty entry, and the one-argument licence helper skips that seeded slot when scanning for later licences.

`UnitStack_HasBuilder` is an exact type-17 membership test, and the strategic queue helpers enable bridge crossings only when that predicate succeeds, allowing builder-containing stacks to route through bridge crossings.

The one-argument castle licence helper explicitly skips builder licences while scanning for later roster entries, and the same subsystem treats type `17` as construction labor by subtracting each garrisoned builder from remaining build time.

Each garrisoned builder adds the literal constant `26` from `g_BuilderConstructionProgressPerTurn` to the per-turn construction reduction path, and `Building_CalcRemainingConstructionTurns` divides the remaining timer by the same constant to estimate turns left.
`Port_CollectReinforcementShipment` draws spawned unit ids from a fixed pool that includes type `17` in the asm-decoded roster `{0,1,2,3,4,5,7,9,10,15,16,17}`.
